title: Decision-Relevance Event Ontology + Recency Inflation Firewall

major_work.problem: Current issue importance gives every sufficiently recent issue up to +8 recency points regardless of event type or decision relevance. A fresh announcement/recruitment-style item can therefore enter the ranked issue surface even with no market channel, market, stock, official evidence, or market-fact signal.

live_evidence.code_evidence: src/kmb_lab/pipeline.py::_issue_importance computes score = publishers*4 + articles*1.5 + channels*2 + official*10 + recency; recency is event-type agnostic.

major_work.non_claim: This does not assert that the award announcement is worthless or that it must be deleted. It shows that freshness can materially elevate an item before decision relevance is established.
architecture: raw article/issue -> event-type classifier -> decision-relevance eligibility -> evidence strength -> Korea transmission path -> horizon relevance -> recency decay conditioned on event type -> diversified ranking

Separate PUBLIC_NOTICE, AWARD/RECRUITMENT, EVENT_PREVIEW, CORPORATE_ACTION, POLICY_DECISION, MACRO_RELEASE, EARNINGS/GUIDANCE, SUPPLY_CONTRACT, REGULATORY_ACTION, MARKET_MOVE_EXPLAINER, OPINION/EDITORIAL, UNKNOWN.
Recency is a multiplier/decay within an eligible event class, not an unconditional additive reward.
A low-decision-value item remains searchable in the full feed; it is not silently deleted.
UNKNOWN or ambiguous event types abstain from directional inference and can enter a review/background lane without occupying scarce top-decision slots.
invariants: freshness alone cannot create decision relevance
event type does not imply bullish/bearish direction
PRIMARY authority and decision relevance remain separate dimensions
market confirmation cannot use data preceding first-observed/event availability
full-feed recall is preserved even when top-attention eligibility is denied

relation_to_prior_work.NEWS-011: admission/market-news quality gate; NEWS-027 focuses on event semantics after ingestion and prevents recency from dominating ranking.
relation_to_prior_work.NEWS-022: portfolio-diverse attention ranking; NEWS-027 supplies a pre-ranking event-type/decision-value prior so diversity optimization does not spend slots on fresh but non-actionable notices.
relation_to_prior_work.NEWS-025: official release interpretation; NEWS-027 is source-agnostic and distinguishes event classes before release-specific delta interpretation.

validation_handoff.experiment: Compare current additive-recency importance vs simple notice-keyword exclusion vs NEWS-027 event-ontology-conditioned recency on PIT Top-3/5/10.
metrics: precision@K for subsequently material market events
top-K slot occupancy by low-information/non-decision events
validation_handoff.leakage_guard: Labels and features must be available at ranking time; future price reaction may be used only as evaluation outcome.

tasks: Find public notices/awards/event previews that unexpectedly produced immediate material Korean-market moves.
Test whether apparently low-value notices contained hidden policy, capital-allocation, regulatory, or corporate-action information.
Attack ontology ambiguity and headline-only classification; verify whether full article/primary evidence is needed.

requirements: persist event_type, decision_relevance_state, reason_codes, as_of/evidence IDs
regression invariant: recency alone cannot move an ineligible event into decision Top-K
do not disable collectors or automation for classification uncertainty

kill_criteria: A simple notice-keyword rule matches OOS gains without meaningful recall loss.
Material-event recall falls more than false-priority reduction justifies.
Improvement comes mainly from broad abstention or deleting feed items.
Reliable event typing requires future information unavailable at decision time.

pages_candidate.rule: Do not remove background items from the full feed.

small_works.action: Do not repeat bridge-cluster investigation without new evidence.
